name: context-towel
description: Shared markdown card library + context graph application. Don't panic.

scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npx tauri build -c src-tauri/tauri.conf.json
scripts.build:lib: npm run build -w packages/card-library && npm run build -w packages/markdown && npm run build -w packages/context-graph
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/card-library/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/markdown/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/context-graph/tsconfig.json
